title: The War Against Iran is "Restarting" --- f**k
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: Sees a 95% chance of a deal in the current window (from Oct 20), falling to 70% after Oct 29 and 30% after the Nov 3 election, when markets turn bearish into winter.
Without the money printer gold struggles; needs Kevin Warsh out of the Fed for gold to move.
Brent at a 5-month high near $111 is weighing on airlines and stoking inflation-expectation fears alongside AI-bubble funding worries.

calls.condition: buy the dip 707-700; if no Iran deal by after the Nov 3 election, turns bearish ("bear mode")
calls.reason: Rejected 715 as called and bouncing at the 707 line; deal window favors buying dips, but odds fall after the election.
calls.quote: I like the idea of buying the dip at my 707 line or even... the 700 line if you really want to be aggressive

calls.reason: Called 5.27 as the top; yield down 13.5bp and about to break below 5%; TLT bottoming on 77-78 weekly line, now 81.25.
calls.quote: the 10-year Treasury is about to break below 5%

calls.reason: Gold sells off even in war because the money printer is off; needs Warsh to exit the Fed.
calls.quote: When you take the money printer away, it's really hard for gold to go up

notes: TLT view merged into TNX call (inverse). SpaceX (SPCX) call of rejection at ~165 to 150 was a prior-day prediction already reached; no new forward view, so not recorded. Brent mentioned at $111 with no forward call. Weekday Wednesday referenced as past, consistent with listing date Thu Oct 22.
